dict.string: Jump to a GitHub pull request (gh <number> [<repo>])

Usage: gh 1234 https://github.com/sfcompute/sfcompute/pull/1234 gh 1234 sfc_base_image https://github.com/sfcompute/sfc_base_image/pull/1234 gh 1234 eculver/foo https://github.com/eculver/foo/pull/1234
With no repo, the configured Default Repository is used. A bare repo name is qualified with the owner of the Default Repository. An owner/repo argument is used as-is.
Enter opens the pull request. Cmd+Enter opens its Files changed tab. Option+Enter opens the repo's pull request list. Cmd+C copies the URL.
Set the Default Repository in this workflow's Configuration.
Used when no repo is given. Its owner is also the default organization for a bare repo name.
